# Riccardo Carlesso's Blog (ricc.rocks) — LLM & Agent Index

> This site is the personal and technical blog of Riccardo Carlesso (Palladius / RiccardinoCM26 🦖), Google Cloud Developer Advocate, SRE, and AI / Agentic systems practitioner.

## 🌐 Supported Languages
The blog natively supports **two primary languages**:
1. **English (EN)**: `https://ricc.rocks/en/` (Default & main technical articles)
2. **Italian (IT)**: `https://ricc.rocks/it/` (Italian posts, personal musings & localized bio)

Additional experimental locales: German (`/de/`), French (`/fr/`), Japanese (`/jp/`).

---

## 🔎 How to Search Posts
AI Agents and search crawlers can discover and query all posts through the following structured endpoints:

### 1. JSON Search Index Feeds
- **English Posts Index**: [`https://ricc.rocks/en/index.json`](https://ricc.rocks/en/index.json)
- **Italian Posts Index**: [`https://ricc.rocks/it/index.json`](https://ricc.rocks/it/index.json)
Each entry in the JSON feed contains: `title`, `uri`, `description`, `tags`, `section`, and full text `content`.

### 2. RSS & Section Feeds
- **English Feed**: `https://ricc.rocks/en/index.xml` or `https://ricc.rocks/en/posts/index.xml`
- **Italian Feed**: `https://ricc.rocks/it/index.xml` or `https://ricc.rocks/it/posts/index.xml`

### 3. Key Categories & Tags
- Antigravity / Agents: `https://ricc.rocks/en/tags/antigravity/`
- Ruby / Rails: `https://ricc.rocks/en/tags/ruby/`
- SRE & Cloud: `https://ricc.rocks/en/tags/sre/`
- Google Cloud: `https://ricc.rocks/en/tags/google/`
